rules.title: Authority and separation
rules.rule: ASH owns the nine-bit model, codewords, classification and recovery meaning. Aeostara owns concrete JSON mapping/materialization. Ambiguous base adaptation yields to ASH. No Windows-specific meanings or advanced pins.

rules.title: Complete semantic input tuple
rules.rule: Immutable observed and desired snapshots; profile ID/revision/hash; JSON canonicalization rule/revision; applicable invariant bundle ID/hash; all evidence snapshots and source bindings; ASH pin/C identity; recognized-valid domain catalog ID/revision/hash; full lifecycle/correction/fallback context; recovery registry ID/revision/hash; selected-target reference; realization rule identity; policy bundle/decision; backup/verification/execution context where applicable. Unavailable fields are explicitly unavailable, never silently defaulted.
rules.determinism: Same complete input tuple yields same semantic result. Diagnostic event IDs/times and host I/O outcomes are explicitly supplied or excluded from the semantic comparison, never hidden semantic inputs.
rules.binding: semantic input digest excludes expected assertions, fixture IDs, machine names and filesystem enumeration order; record raw source identity separately from semantic canonical digest

rules.title: All nine coordinate meanings
rules.rule: b0 through b8 are exactly the nine equal binary coordinates in canonical order. No privileged or business meaning. C having b8=0 does not remove b8 from state projection, diagnosis, classification or verification.

rules.title: Pointer, null and structure semantics
rules.rule: Use JSON Pointer; root is empty Pointer, '/' selects an empty-key object member, '.' in a key is literal, ~0/~1 decode escaped tokens, missing and explicit null are distinct, arrays preserve order.

rules.title: Concrete binary evaluator
rules.rule: Evaluate only explicit profile source bindings using genuine extracted snapshot values. An exact mathematical JSON numeric 0 or 1 yields that bit. Bool, string, null, other numbers, wrong carrier structure or malformed claim metadata fail. Missing required source/Pointer blocks. Unknown evaluator/evidence-kind blocks. Supported claims agreeing on one bit map; differing genuine bits are ambiguous. Desired is independently projected when needed and never substitutes for observed.
rules.noImplicitSources: Supplemental evidence is read only where an explicit immutable profile binding requires it; no implicit override or guessed alias.

rules.title: No manufactured full state on incomplete mapping

sources.symbol: No fabricated empty state; explicit C++ error results

rules.rule: Create a full state only after nine genuine unique bits exist. Otherwise retain all per-coordinate outcomes, real evidence, faults and diagnostics in typed unsuccessful attempt. No zero padding, missing bindings, guessed diagnostics or fabricated canonical hash.

rules.title: Recognized valid state catalog and admissibility evidence
rules.rule: After adoption of fixed K, x in K is VALID; otherwise x xor k in canonical C for any k in K proves TRANSFORMATION_COMPATIBLE; no witness with a complete evaluable fixed catalog/C proves TRANSFORMATION_INCOMPATIBLE; actual inability to evaluate canonical evidence produces UNCLASSIFIED. Witness retains k,c,source identities and all nine bits. A failed JSON projection does not invent x or automatically call this classifier.
rules.unresolved: The canonical recognized-valid set/owner is not supplied. K is not C and must not vary covertly for the same canonical state/C. Synthetic K requires explicit immutable authority reconciliation.

rules.title: Canonical classification
rules.rule: SAFE_HALT context first; then CONTAINED; VALID+ALREADY_VALID→STABLE; TRANSFORMATION_COMPATIBLE+NORMALIZABLE→CORRECTABLE when specific correction known else UNSTABLE; TRANSFORMATION_INCOMPATIBLE→DEGRADED if fallback available else FAILED; remaining/UNCLASSIFIED→DEGRADED. Preserve immediate classification separately from subsequent recovery escalation.
unresolvedDependencies: adoption of concrete selected-and-validated correction_path_is_known witness predicate

rules.title: Canonical class to recovery and blocked transitions
rules.rule: Recovery category identifies allowed semantics; it does not itself authorize or implement a JSON repair.

rules.title: Canonical fallback registry procedure

sources.symbol: get_fallback_candidates, select_fallback_candidate, Candidate eligibility, Deterministic ordering, Escalation

rules.rule: Explicit immutable registry entries; all applicability predicates; lower rank then policy ID; genuine known-valid candidate; re-diagnose and require STABLE; TRY_NEXT or ESCALATE_TO_CONTAINMENT; no valid candidate means recorded containment; no heuristic fallback.
rules.unresolved: Actual domain registry entries and undefined fallback_is_available predicate are absent. Synthetic registry and preflight are proposals, not established authority.

rules.title: Authorized inverse and concrete operations
rules.rule: Every step binds an adopted inverse rule, real source state, authorized target, witness, permitted Pointer scope and exact before/after values. Synthetic inverse only replaces changed existing /state_vector/i numeric slots. A target must be explicitly authorized and in fixed K; desired is only intent. NORMALIZE/APPLY_CORRECTION additionally require canonical codeword path; FALLBACK additionally requires selected eligible validated registry entry. NO_ACTION emits no mutations even for surface drift. Other recovery categories invoke explicit containment/escalation/halt capabilities, not invented configuration writes.
rules.unsupported: Absent adopted inverse/target permission or policy authorization blocks product planning/execution while preserving genuine mathematical witness, canonical class and recovery category. It does not mean the mathematical path is not computable, does not by itself trigger canonical path-not-computable escalation, and never automatically authorizes fallback. Invoke canonical blocked-recovery transition only with actual matching source condition; any later fallback requires separately justified category/registry/target/policy/backup authority. No category-to-diff shortcut.

rules.title: Policy, stale, backup and capability gates
rules.rule: No mutation in observation/projection/diagnosis/classification/planning/dry-run. Before mutation require exact profile/catalog/registry/policy identities, policy ALLOW, authorized scope, generated verification plan, confirmed pre-execution diagnostics/audit, exclusive host capability, current canonical/raw snapshot matching planned preconditions, verified uniquely stored backup and armed recovery. A stale identity blocks the attempt before writes; a new attempt requires new observation/plan/policy/backup, never silent reuse.
rules.backup: Claim backup success only after genuine copy/write confirmation and verified source bytes/hash; absence/false/throw gates mutation off. Filesystem details belong to platform binding.

rules.title: Verification postconditions
rules.rule: After execution re-read actual bytes, strict-parse, re-project with identical immutable profile/evidence dependencies, diagnose full nine bits, verify authorized target, canonical STABLE where correction/fallback requires it, all declared invariants, all intended operations and unchanged protected scope. Do not compare only desired subset. Failed/blocked verification prevents HEALED/success and enters explicit recovery.

rules.title: Truthful failure and rollback
rules.rule: Arm recovery before first possible mutation. False returns and exceptions after partial writes, verification errors or persistence failure retain the primary outcome and attempt authorized restore. Restoration succeeds only after adapter confirmation plus exact byte equality/raw hash to the captured original and explicit restoration-safety invariants. Preserve preexisting repair postcondition violations and failed healing outcome; restored does not imply VALID/STABLE/HEALED or automatic resume. False/throw/unverifiable restore is FAILED, preserves both primary and recovery faults, and uses declared escalation/containment/halt. Do not claim rolled back from call completion. No destructive re-plan or terminal-state repair.

rules.title: Conservative exact JSON supplement
rules.rule: See canonicalizationProposal. Existing generic source requires deterministic canonicalization but does not settle all lexical/numeric/duplicate/Unicode/index details. This proposed precision is unapproved; Python float/json library behavior is observed reference behavior, not silently replaced normative authority.

rules.title: Genuine diagnostics and source references
rules.rule: Retain genuine source/evidence, exact source pins, existing permitted diagnostic kinds, root/parent relationships and source rule families. Every failure and recovery action emits a diagnostic. JASH IDs identify proposal traceability only; do not replace canonical ASH rule IDs or claim their adoption.
rules.proposedExportPrecision: Semantic deterministic payload is separate from explicitly supplied event IDs/timestamps. Serialize the same diagnostic chain to JSON/Markdown with identical statuses, evidence and refs; serialization/persistence failure is a retained error.

rules.title: Independent fixtures and oracle
rules.rule: Runtime actual() receives complete inputs only, never expected/class labels/fixture IDs. Assert separately. Preserve original fixtures/expected bytes and source hashes. New synthetic vectors are labeled proposals; a passing independent explicit-class map check proves only that map, not projection or release acceptance.

rules.title: Frozen DTO applicability and typed unsuccessful operations

sources.symbol: explicit C++ error results, schema-valid returned contracts, no fabricated empty state

rules.rule: Source supports native explicit error mechanics but does not by itself authorize outer failure as the promised frozen return DTO. Proposed OperationAttempt<T> has either complete truthful schema-valid T or typed failure with genuine available evidence, missing-evidence reasons and diagnostics. It never makes required frozen fields optional/null/empty. Some negative frozen DTOs are returnable when all required actual evidence genuinely exists; unavailable values require authoritative clarification or a new versioned schema.

sources.symbol: Preconditions: supplied references resolvable; no fabricated state or diagnostics

sourceEvidenceProposal.genuineDefinition: An actual captured immutable source snapshot and value extracted at the declared Pointer; its sourceReference resolves to that exact snapshot identity/canonical content hash/Pointer/coordinate/evidence kind and an adopted host-registered source authority. Nonempty string alone is not provenance, authentication or authority.

authorityRefShape.semanticDefinitionHash: lowercase SHA256 of canonical exact authorityDefinitionProjection

sourceEvidenceProposal.registration: Complete input includes registeredAuthorityRef and actual immutable source-authority definition. The expected authority comes from adopted profile/host source capability, not from the claim itself. Verify exact allowed source names/kinds and identity. Synthetic registration is explicit mock/test setup, never production authentication.

references.canonicalDocumentHash: computed from actual immutable captured claims document

sourceEvidenceProposal.resolution: Resolve metadata sourceReference through a unique manifest reference record. Match adopted/registered authority ID/revision/semantic hash, sourceName, actual snapshot ID and computed canonical document hash, exact Pointer, coordinate and kind; then extract actual snapshot value and run binary evaluator. Manifest and captured sources are explicit hashed immutable inputs. No asserted/external value may override snapshot extraction.
sourceEvidenceProposal.identity: Transport paths and raw file hashes stay provenance; authority semantic hash uses exact projection above. Source snapshot canonicalDocumentHash is computed from actual captured document bytes/parsed content under proposed adopted canonicalization, not an expected assertion.
sourceEvidenceProposal.adoption: Actual authority/registration and source attestation semantics require an immutable adopted domain/source-capability supplement. Demo manifest proves only consistency against explicit proposed captured fixture data, not authenticity of a production source.

invariantBoundaryProposal.declaration: Every applicable invariant has immutable ID/revision/source, fully defined predicate and genuine evidence, one explicit role and mandatory/diagnostic disposition. Undefined role/predicate/evidence is BLOCKED; never assume empty policies or ignored violations.
invariantBoundaryProposal.evaluation: Pure evaluation within observation/normalization/policy and verification uses immutable snapshot evidence and records PASS/VIOLATION/UNAVAILABLE with actual rule/source/values. It never mutates or secretly changes coordinate bits.
invariantBoundaryProposal.noAction: Canonical STABLE/NO_ACTION is retained when x belongs to adopted K. Overall lifecycle success/healthy is permitted only when all mandatory LIFECYCLE_SUCCESS_POSTCONDITION predicates pass. Violation/unavailable records real failure and BLOCKED/typed unsuccessful product result with no mutation; it does not invent a different ASH class/category or generic repair.
invariantBoundaryProposal.beforeMutation: Mandatory MUTATION_PRECONDITION predicates must pass. A preexisting repair-trigger violation of LIFECYCLE_SUCCESS_POSTCONDITION may be repaired only by an independently authorized canonical recovery plan and adopted inverse/target/policy; it is not silently a mutation precondition. Such predicates must pass after recovery for HEALED.
invariantBoundaryProposal.restore: Verified restoration requires checked restore plus exact byte equality/raw hash to captured original and explicit mandatory RESTORATION_SAFETY predicates. It does not require fixing preexisting repair postcondition violations; preserve those violations and the initiating failed healing outcome. Restoration success does not imply VALID/STABLE/HEALED or automatic resume.
invariantBoundaryProposal.diagnosticOnly: Record diagnostic-only results truthfully; do not claim their violation blocks lifecycle unless an adopted policy says so.

Canonicalize then hash. witnessID is not inside payload.
semanticIdentityProposal.evidenceSourceReference: Nonempty immutable platform-neutral logical/source authority identifier or content-addressed URN; local filesystem paths and transport URLs are not witness semantic source IDs.
semanticIdentityProposal.excluded: Transport path/locator, local volume/host, file formatting/newline/raw file hash, display/review/adoption status, notes, timestamp, witnessID and other nonsemantic metadata. Retain these separately as provenance/execution preconditions where applicable.
semanticIdentityProposal.reproducibility: Relocating the same artifacts or changing a review display label cannot change semantic definition/witness identity. A changed semantic definition, evidence authority identity, source/target state or codeword sequence does change identity.
semanticIdentityProposal.adoption: The projection of semantic fields itself requires adoption; no present reference canonical hash is redefined.

correctionPathIsKnown.definition: True only for an explicitly selected, immutable-source-bound correctionPath whose full witness validates against the actual full observed state, fixed K and pinned canonical C. Exhaustive orbit/path existence alone does not imply selected/known correction context.

correctionPathIsKnown.notSelectedMeaning: Explicit supplemental tagged absence, not an optional/null frozen DTO field. With compatible NORMALIZABLE evidence, this makes canonical correction_path_is_known false and class UNSTABLE. It does not deny existence of a normalization path.
correctionPathIsKnown.notEvaluated: Allowed before diagnosis; if compatible classification requires this context and it remains not_evaluated or unavailable, return typed BLOCKED rather than silently choose known/unknown.
correctionPathIsKnown.mutationAuthorization: Selected validated mathematical witness does not itself authorize target materialization; inverse, target authority, scope, policy and backup gates remain separate.

An availability=true flag with empty/ineligible registry is inconsistent; a flag alone cannot manufacture or hide candidates. Synthetic unavailable fixture supplies a separately hashed empty registry variant.

availabilityRule.rule: Before canonical classification, availability is an existence preflight over eligible re-diagnosed candidates using the full diagnostic and immutable registry; it does not recursively call get_fallback_candidates whose precondition is DEGRADED. After classification, canonical selection requires DEGRADED. Execution policy authorization occurs after planning and never turns a valid mapping into a different bit value.

syntheticFallbackRegistry.idReservation: IDs shown are synthetic examples; adopting entries requires reserving globally unique identifiers or replacing them in an immutable adopted supplement.

canonicalizationProposal.input: UTF-8 JSON bytes without BOM; no comments, trailing commas, NaN/Infinity, invalid UTF-8 or unpaired surrogate. Preserve original bytes separately for rollback.
canonicalizationProposal.grammar: JSON number -?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?; ASCII digits only; bounded exact signed coefficient plus decimal exponent, no binary floating conversion. Count all significand digits before insignificant-zero removal; written exponent magnitude <=4096; effective exponent is written exponent minus fraction length, then adjusted for removed coefficient trailing zeros, magnitude <=5120. Reject resource limits explicitly before expansion; root has depth 1; each value/container is one node; limits apply to every document, decoded key/string, Pointer and aggregate complete input.
canonicalizationProposal.numericCanonicalization: Normalize negative zero to 0. Remove insignificant leading/trailing coefficient zeros, then emit the exact expanded decimal with no exponent, no plus sign, no unnecessary fractional zeros or trailing decimal point. Examples: 1.0→1; 1e3→1000; 1e-3→0.001; -0.0→0; 9007199254740993 remains exact.
canonicalizationProposal.numericEquality: Exact mathematical decimal equality (1 == 1.0 == 1e0); bool is not numeric; binary evaluator accepts exact values 0/1 under this rule.
canonicalizationProposal.duplicateMembers: Reject duplicate decoded object keys before constructing a lookup map, including a and \u0061. No last/first-wins interpretation.
canonicalizationProposal.unicode: Unicode scalar values, no normalization/casefolding. Reject invalid UTF-8/overlong encodings/surrogates; paired escaped surrogate encodes its scalar. Preserve scalar sequence.
canonicalizationProposal.stringCanonicalization: UTF-8, escape quote and backslash; use \b,\t,\n,\f,\r for those controls, lowercase \u00xx for other U+0000..001F; slash unescaped; other scalars literal UTF-8.
canonicalizationProposal.objectCanonicalization: Sort decoded keys by unsigned UTF-8 byte lexicographic order; no whitespace; canonical key/value encoding.
canonicalizationProposal.arrayCanonicalization: Retain exact element order; no whitespace.
canonicalizationProposal.hashing: lowercase SHA256 hex of canonical UTF-8 bytes. Raw-byte hash uses original UTF-8 bytes and is distinct. Immutable input references use separate canonical hash and actual content/source identity.
canonicalizationProposal.pointers: Validate leading '/' except empty root; decode ~0/~1 exactly once; other ~escape invalid. Object tokens literal. Arrays require ASCII 0 or [1-9][0-9]*, no leading zeros, sign, Unicode digits or '-' for reads. Bounds checked exactly; missing is distinct from null. Wrong container type fails, absent object key/index blocks. These precision rules require adoption because source JsonPointerEvaluator currently accepts decimal/leading-zero indices more broadly.
canonicalizationProposal.authoritativeReferenceReconciliation: Source common_checks.py uses Python json serialization and binary float parsing, duplicate-last-wins loading and broad isdecimal array indexing. Adopting this exact proposal requires an immutable JSON clarification plus supplementary cross-platform/reference fixtures; do not silently change the frozen reference or claim equivalence for all numbers.
